stage1_evidence_shown.label: INTRODUCTION
stage1_evidence_shown.context: Recent suicide bombings pose the novel problem for Trauma Centers of the massive simultaneous arrival of many gravely wounded patients.

stage1_evidence_shown.label: METHODS
stage1_evidence_shown.context: We report the experience of the French-German Military Trauma Group, a Level 2 Trauma Center, in Afghanistan during the wave of suicide bombings in February 2007.

stage2_added_evidence.label: RESULTS
stage2_added_evidence.context: Fourteen casualties were received. A first triage was carried out by the U S Army Level I group prior to evacuation. A second surgical triage was carried out with systematic ultrasound exam. Four cases (ISS>25) were re-categorized and underwent emergency surgical procedures.
